meta.inspection: All 25 images individually inspected using view_image. Exact anchors preserved from own prior image hashes. No source, key or other judges inspected. Near-identical carrier scenes judged visually with no novelty reward.
meta.blinding_limitations: Repeated controls and visual families recognizable; sci-fi resembles StarCraft, battlefields Company of Heroes; tactical title uncertain.

view-01.png.evidence: Cyan circle clearly locates aircraft over grass/rocks; soft coast scene remains readable.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Broad glowing shoreline lacks irregular surf structure and emphasizes artificial edge. Grass flat and trees carry heavy repeated contact shadows.

view-02.png.evidence: Cyan player circle provides a focal location amid pale overlapping aircraft; dark hull and sea remain legible.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Ring cannot separate overlapping aircraft within it. Equal orange impacts and smoke stamps still fragment attention; soft edges limit definition. Near-match to prior carrier scene: no score-level visual difference at phone display size.

general_next_priorities: Make shore foam irregular in width, opacity and distance from water edge, with short connected patches rather than thin dashed rails.
Preserve ring clarity while separating aircraft material from deck and hangar.
Improve major-versus-minor impact hierarchy; dense equal sparks and repeated smoke remain distracting.
Coordinate ocean texture, land shading and vessel materials; detail alone does not resolve style mismatch.
